steps.en: Install the official app and harness; verify and extract the matching LCU release
steps.zh: 安装官方应用与宿主，核验并解压对应发布包

steps.en: Register Codex from the extracted macOS release
steps.zh: 从解压后的 macOS 发布包注册 Codex

steps.en: Validate the installed app and register the computer-use adapter
steps.zh: 检查本机应用，注册电脑控制适配器

steps.en: Restart the harness, request a harmless window screenshot and approve access
steps.zh: 重启宿主，请求无敏感内容的窗口截图并批准访问

steps.en: Run the installed app's computer-use engine and return the screenshot to the agent
steps.zh: 调用已装应用的电脑控制引擎，把截图返回 agent

value.en: Your existing coding agent can inspect a native app without you rebuilding desktop-control plumbing
value.zh: 现有编程 agent 能读取原生应用，不必另写桌面控制接线
